summary: One independent v11 review passed the self-contained design, but the lead review found an unresolved P1: M6ReplayInputBinding v6 treats every entry as an existing hashed ArtifactRef while also requiring a fresh non-existent output root. A distinct output namespace/reservation and atomic absence-claim contract is needed; the stricter finding controls routing.

limitations: Reviews were read-only and made no product, test, contract, gate, ledger, or historical-evidence changes.
No empirical training, replay, PIT certification, budget consumption, or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: Do not enter test design or implementation until a fresh replay-output reservation contract passes independent review; M7, replay, CCC/Gate, and final OOS remain sealed.
